decisions.reason: As a recent launch that builds directly on the firm's core authentication and secure communication offering and is already publicly presented, management is likely to continue it rather than admit an early reversal.

The mobile PDF digital signature function fits the firm's stated move toward app-based interactions and online signing, so prior investment and strategic fit make withdrawal unlikely after only one year.

This end-to-end security architecture is highly consistent with the firm's established technical base and long-term direction, giving management strong reasons to persist despite any early uncertainty.

Although somewhat more specific in application, it still extends the firm's secure cross-channel communication logic, and escalation of commitment favors keeping a newly launched, publicly visible product.

This hardware signature token is slightly more niche and may be less central than pure software modules, but the firm's existing hardware capabilities and public commitment still make continuation more likely than exit.
The compliance suite builds on the firm's security and regulatory-strength positioning, so management is likely to justify and continue the investment unless poor results become unmistakable.
